args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the latest deploy of v2.3.1 to production (all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Error rate was 0.18 and health status was unhealthy. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified and rolled out successfully.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified and rolled out successfully (approved by the human approver).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the successful verification. The on-call engineer was paged.
